LanguageData.ShiftChange.InspectPoolDisabled: Unassigned: shared use is turned off in mod settings.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.InspectOutsideArea: This stand is outside {0}'s allowed area, so they will keep the outfit on. Change back still sends them here.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.InspectEmpty: Empty: put an outfit on it.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.SetWorkTypeDesc:
This stand dresses for: {0} ({1}).

Whoever uses it changes into the outfit before starting automatic work or recreation of those kinds in this room, and changes back when they leave.

This switch also decides which mod's owner control the stand shows when another outfit-stand mod is installed: in service, Shift Change's; not used, the other mod's.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.SetWorkTypeDescRadius:
This stand dresses for: {0} ({1}), within {2} cells of it.

Whoever uses it changes into the outfit before starting automatic work, recreation or sleep of those kinds inside that radius. Inside it the outfit stays on for those, for idling and wandering, and for walking back into their allowed area or out of the heat or cold. At a work stand, hauling, cleaning and building keep it on as well; at a sleep stand, only bed does. Most other jobs, and most jobs outside the radius, send them back to change first.

This switch also decides which mod's owner control the stand shows when another outfit-stand mod is installed: in service, Shift Change's; not used, the other mod's.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.SetWorkTypeDescArea:
This stand dresses for: {0} ({1}), in its allowed area: {3}.

Whoever uses it changes into the outfit before starting automatic work, recreation or sleep of those kinds inside that area. Inside it the outfit stays on for those, for idling and wandering, and for walking back into the area they are restricted to or out of the heat or cold. At a work stand, hauling, cleaning and building keep it on as well; at a sleep stand, only bed does. Most other jobs, and most jobs outside the area, send them back to change first.

This switch also decides which mod's owner control the stand shows when another outfit-stand mod is installed: in service, Shift Change's; not used, the other mod's.

LanguageData.ShiftChange.WorkTypesExplainerArea: Ticked activities, done in its allowed area, trigger a change into this stand's outfit:
LanguageData.ShiftChange.NoWorkTypes: No work types exist to tick, here or anywhere. They are gone from the work tab as well, so a mod that rearranges work categories has hidden them.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.RecreationRow: Recreation: any joy activity in this room
LanguageData.ShiftChange.RecreationRowRadius: Recreation: any joy activity within its radius
LanguageData.ShiftChange.RecreationRowArea: Recreation: any joy activity in its allowed area
LanguageData.ShiftChange.RecreationExclusiveNote: While recreation is on, this stand serves recreation only; work types do not apply.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.RestRow: Sleeping: going to bed in this room
LanguageData.ShiftChange.RestRowRadius: Sleeping: going to bed within its radius
LanguageData.ShiftChange.RestRowArea: Sleeping: going to bed in its allowed area
LanguageData.ShiftChange.RestExclusiveNote: While sleeping is on, this stand serves bedtime only; work types do not apply. Bed rest for medical reasons is a work type, 'resting in bed', and is not covered by this row.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.DepositOnlyDesc:
Normally a stand hands out an outfit and takes in whatever it displaces, so a sleeping stand wants pyjamas on it.

With this on it hands out nothing. A colonist heading for bed parks whatever this stand's storage filter accepts, keeps the rest of their clothes on, and collects it again in the morning. It is the setting for a rack by the bed that your marine drops power armor onto every night.

The storage filter decides which garments come off, and you will want to NARROW it. A new stand already accepts nearly all clothing, so leave it alone and this stand tries to take almost everything a colonist is wearing. Use the storage tab to allow only the gear you want parked.

Haulers leave a deposit-only stand alone, so it holds what its owner parked there and nothing else. You can still carry something onto it yourself with a right-click order.

It will never send a colonist to bed naked: if what the filter would take leaves them without basic clothing, the stand is skipped for that colonist entirely. So a soldier who wears nothing under their armor needs something to change into, or a set of clothes underneath, before this will do anything for them.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.FullChangeDepositNote: Not used while this stand is set to deposit only. A deposit-only stand hands out no outfit, so there is no whole outfit to change into.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.TriggerFromRoomNote: This stand's trigger comes from the room it stands in. Tick a work type to override it.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.TriggerTickedNote: Ticking a work type switches this stand to work instead.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.InspectDepositOnly: Deposit only: takes in what its storage filter allows
LanguageData.ShiftChange.FullChangeDesc:
Normally a pawn keeps whatever this stand's kit does not conflict with, so the uniform goes on over their own clothes.

With this on they undress completely and wear only what the stand holds. That is right for a sauna robe, and slower in both directions, since every garment is taken off and put back on.

Everything their own clothes were providing comes off with them: warmth, armor, any bonuses those garments carried. They have exactly what the stand holds and nothing more.

If Keep colonists decent is enabled in the mod settings, one exception applies: where what the stand holds would leave them without basic clothing, they keep their innermost garments on instead. That setting is off by default.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.WithholdFromTradeDesc:
Traders will buy anything sitting on an outfit stand: the uniform, and the owner's own clothes parked there while they are on shift. Nothing about the stand marks it off limits. 'Allow removing items' does not cover trade, and neither does an assigned owner.

With this on, this stand's contents never reach a trade window, whether the trader is a caravan at the gate or a ship in orbit. Nothing else changes: colonists still stock the stand, shift changes still work, and you can still load the kit into a caravan yourself.

Turn it off for a stand you keep as a shop shelf.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.InspectTradeable: Contents can be sold to traders
LanguageData.ShiftChange.RoomReadsAs: the game reads this room as: {0}
LanguageData.ShiftChange.NoRoomRole: this spot is not in a roled room
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AutomaticRoomOnly: Automatic reads the stand's room, so it needs Serves: This room. Switch that below first.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.ServesDesc:
Where this stand dresses colonists, and where they keep its outfit on.

This room: the stand's own room. This is the default.

Within a radius: every cell inside the ring, walls or no walls.

An allowed area: the cells painted in it, while the stand stands on one of them. These are the same allowed areas you restrict colonists to in the Schedule tab, so painting one for this stand also changes it for any colonist restricted to it.

The ring or the area is drawn while this window is open and whenever the stand is selected. Inside either, a colonist keeps the outfit on for what the stand is for, for idling and wandering, and for walking somewhere allowed or out of the heat or cold. At a work stand, hauling, cleaning and building keep it on as well; at a sleep stand, only bed does. Most other jobs send them back to change first.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.ServesNothingOutdoorsDesc: Standing in the open, its room is all the open ground on the map, so a stand serving its room serves nothing there. Choose Within a radius, or an allowed area, to serve the ground around it.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.ServesAreaGoneDesc: Its allowed area is gone, so this stand serves nothing until you choose what it serves again.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.ServesAreaWithoutStandDesc: This stand stands outside its allowed area, so it serves nothing. Paint the area over the stand, or move the stand into it.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.ServesNeedsTrigger: Tick what this stand serves first: a work type, Recreation or Sleeping.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.ServesPaintDesc: Closes this window and starts the Expand allowed area tool on {0}. Clear allowed area, beside it in the Architect's Zone menu, takes cells out again.\n\nPainting the area also changes it for any colonist restricted to it.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.ServesPaintGone: {0} is gone, so there is nothing to paint.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.InspectServesNothingOutdoors: Serves nothing out in the open. Choose a radius or an allowed area in its settings.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.InspectAreaGone: Its allowed area is gone: {0}. It serves nothing until you choose again in its settings.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.InspectStandOutsideArea: Stands outside its allowed area: {0}. It serves nothing until you paint the area over it or move it in.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AlertInTheOpen: {0} ({1}) stands in the open, where its room serves nothing
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AlertAreaGone: {0} ({1}) serves an allowed area that is gone: {2}
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AssignDesc:
Restrict this stand to the colonists you list. Name one and it is their personal kit; name several and it serves that group and nobody outside it.

Leave it unassigned and it is shared: any colonist about to do {0} in this room may use whichever stand is free. A kitchen therefore needs one stand per cook working at once, not one per cook.

The list filters by gender and can assign everyone shown at once, so a stand holding gendered clothing is two clicks away.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AssignDescRadius:
Restrict this stand to the colonists you list. Name one and it is their personal kit; name several and it serves that group and nobody outside it.

Leave it unassigned and it is shared: any colonist about to do {0} within its radius may use whichever stand is free. A kitchen therefore needs one stand per cook working at once, not one per cook.

The list filters by gender and can assign everyone shown at once, so a stand holding gendered clothing is two clicks away.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AssignDescArea:
Restrict this stand to the colonists you list. Name one and it is their personal kit; name several and it serves that group and nobody outside it.

Leave it unassigned and it is shared: any colonist about to do {0} in its allowed area may use whichever stand is free. A kitchen therefore needs one stand per cook working at once, not one per cook.

The list filters by gender and can assign everyone shown at once, so a stand holding gendered clothing is two clicks away.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AssignDescNoPool: Restrict this stand to the colonists you list.\n\nShared use of unassigned stands is turned off in mod settings, so only a listed owner will change at this stand for {0}.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AssignDescNoWork: Restrict this stand to the colonists you list. It has no work type yet: either put it in a room with a role, or set one manually.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AssignDescExcluded:
Choose the one colonist this stand belongs to. It is not used for shift changes, so nobody is dressed here automatically.

If it had several owners in shift use, they stay listed for when you put it back, and choosing one colonist here replaces them.

If Outfit Stands Plus is installed, a single owner also gets the Outfit Stands Plus button for this stand (equip outfit, or return to stand).
LanguageData.ShiftChange.ChangeBackDesc:
Cancel this colonist's orders and send them to {STAND} to change out of their work outfit.

They change back on their own once their next job takes them out of this room, raid or no raid. Use this when that is not soon enough: in an emergency, or when the job they are on will take a long time.

They keep working in this room in their own clothes. Neither {STAND} nor another stand serving the same thing (work, recreation or sleep) whose room, radius or allowed area takes in {STAND} will dress them again until they have left the room, or slept. Drafting them clears that straight away.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.ChangeBackDescRadius:
Cancel this colonist's orders and send them to {STAND} to change out of their work outfit.

They change back on their own before most jobs outside its radius, or that the stand does not keep them dressed for, raid or no raid. Use this when that is not soon enough: in an emergency, or when the job they are on will take a long time.

They keep working in their own clothes. Neither {STAND} nor another stand serving the same thing (work, recreation or sleep) whose room, radius or allowed area takes in {STAND} will dress them again until they have left its radius, or slept. Drafting them clears that straight away.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.ChangeBackDescArea:
Cancel this colonist's orders and send them to {STAND} to change out of their work outfit.

They change back on their own before most jobs outside its allowed area, or that the stand does not keep them dressed for, raid or no raid. Use this when that is not soon enough: in an emergency, or when the job they are on will take a long time.

They keep working in their own clothes. Neither {STAND} nor another stand serving the same thing (work, recreation or sleep) whose room, radius or allowed area takes in {STAND} will dress them again until they have left its allowed area, or slept. Drafting them clears that straight away.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.ChangeBackUnavailable: This colonist cannot change right now.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.OrderIntoVacuum: {0} is heading through vacuum in work clothes that protect them less than their own. Press Change back, then give the order again, to send them in their own gear.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.VacuumStandAcrossVacuum: {0} is heading through vacuum in work clothes that protect them less than their own. Their own clothes are across vacuum too, so they will not go back to change first.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.VacuumStandElsewhere: {0} is heading through vacuum in work clothes that protect them less than their own, and their own clothes are not on this map.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.SettingPoolUnassignedDesc: When on, an outfit stand with no assigned owner may be used by any colonist about to do what it serves.\n\nWhen off, only stands with an explicit owner list ever dress anyone, and every unassigned stand behaves exactly like vanilla furniture.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.SettingKeepDecentDesc:
Off by default, so nothing changes in a colony you are already playing.

Turn it on and a stand will not leave a colonist without basic clothing: if what it hands out does not cover them, their innermost garments stay on and the rest of the swap happens as normal. That mostly matters with Change the whole outfit ticked, where a stand holding only a hat or a belt would otherwise send someone out with nothing else on.

Nudists, and anyone whose ideoligion prefers nudity, are exempt either way.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.SettingMedicalEmergenciesDes:
Off by default, so nothing changes in a colony you are already playing.

Normally an emergency is never delayed for a wardrobe trip. Turn this on and medical ones are: a doctor answering an emergency tend puts scrubs on first, and a colonist in critical condition stops for a hospital gown on the way to bed.

Fires are never covered. A colonist fighting one goes straight there whatever this is set to.

It works both ways round, so a doctor already in another stand's uniform may also change out of it before answering the call.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AllowRemovingDesc: Shift Change: kept off while this stand is in service. Colonists stock the stand either way, and changing into its outfit ignores this setting completely, so shift changes work with it off. Turning it on exposes the stand's contents to every colonist's outfit optimizer, which will take the uniform and wear it as everyday clothes if it outscores what they have on.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AllowRemovingDisabled: In service for shift changes, which keeps this off: turned on, the stand's contents are exposed to every colonist's outfit optimizer, and an assigned owner does not protect them.\n\nTo take a garment back, use the eject button in the Contents tab. To let haulers empty the stand, set it to 'Not used for shift changes' first.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.Faulted: Shift Change hit repeated errors and has stopped changing colonists for this game. Outfit stands still work as ordinary furniture. Loading a save will start it again; the details are in the dev log.
